court: The European Court of Human Rights (Second Section)

holdings.text: Holds that there has been no violation of Article 2 of the Convention as regards the applicant's allegation that his brother was killed in circumstances engaging the responsibility of agents of the respondent State

anchor.surface_text: 1.  Holds that there has been no violation of Article 2 of the Convention as regards the applicant's allegation that his brother was killed in circumstances engaging the responsibility of agents of the respondent State;

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court found insufficient evidence beyond reasonable doubt to conclude that State agents were responsible for the killing of the applicant's brother, despite allegations and reports suggesting State involvement.

holdings.text: Holds that there has been a violation of Article 2 of the Convention on account of the failure of the authorities of the respondent State to conduct an adequate and effective investigation into the circumstances surrounding the death of the applicant's brother

anchor.surface_text: 2.  Holds that there has been a violation of Article 2 of the Convention on account of the failure of the authorities of the respondent State to conduct an adequate and effective investigation into the circumstances surrounding the death of the applicant's brother;

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court found that the investigation was inadequate and ineffective due to omissions, delays, failure to investigate State agent involvement, and poor coordination among authorities.

holdings.text: Holds that there has been no violation of Article 2 of the Convention in respect of the applicant himself

anchor.surface_text: 3.  Holds that there has been no violation of Article 2 of the Convention in respect of the applicant himself;

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court was not persuaded that the applicant's own right to life was violated or placed at risk to a degree breaching Article 2.

holdings.text: Holds that there has been no violation of Article 3 of the Convention in respect of the applicant's brother

anchor.surface_text: 4.  Holds that there has been no violation of Article 3 of the Convention in respect of the applicant's brother;

holdings.reasoning_summary: Since no State agent involvement was established, there was no factual basis for a violation of Article 3 regarding ill-treatment or torture.

holdings.text: Holds that there has been a violation of Article 13 of the Convention

anchor.surface_text: 5.  Holds that there has been a violation of Article 13 of the Convention;

holdings.reasoning_summary: Due to the lack of an effective investigation, the applicant was denied an effective remedy under Article 13, which requires effective domestic remedies for arguable complaints.

holdings.text: Holds that there has been no violation of Article 14 of the Convention

anchor.surface_text: 6.  Holds that there has been no violation of Article 14 of the Convention;

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court found the applicant's allegations of discrimination unsubstantiated and thus no violation of Article 14.

holdings.text: that the respondent State is to pay the applicant, within three months from the date on which the judgment becomes final according to Article 44 § 2 of the Convention, the following sums free of any tax that may be payable: (i)  EUR 10,000 (ten thousand euros) to the widow and two children of Savaş Buldan in respect of non-pecuniary compensation; (ii)  EUR 6,000 (six thousand euros) to the applicant in respect of compensation for non-pecuniary damage; (iii)  EUR 10,000 (ten thousand euros) in respect of costs and expenses; that from the expiry of the above-mentioned three months until settlement simple interest shall be payable on the above amounts at a rate equal to the marginal lending rate of the European Central Bank during the default period plus three percentage points

anchor.surface_text: 7.  Holds (a)  that the respondent State is to pay the applicant, within three months from the date on which the judgment becomes final according to Article 44 § 2 of the Convention, the following sums free of any tax that may be payable: (i)  EUR 10,000 (ten thousand euros) to the widow and two children of Savaş Buldan in respect of non-pecuniary compensation to be converted into Turkish liras at the rate applicable at the date of payment and to be paid into the bank account of Savaş Buldan's widow and two children; (ii)  EUR 6,000 (six thousand euros) to the applicant in respect of compensation for non-pecuniary damage to be paid into his bank account in Germany; (iii)  EUR 10,000 (ten thousand euros) in respect of costs and expenses, such sum to be converted into pounds sterling and to be paid into the bank account in the United Kingdom indicated by the applicant; (b)  that from the expiry of the above-mentioned three months until settlement simple interest shall be payable on the above amounts at a rate equal to the marginal lending rate of the European Central Bank during the default period plus three percentage points;

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court awarded non-pecuniary damages to the widow and children and to the applicant, as well as costs and expenses, with interest payable after three months.

holdings.text: Dismisses the remainder of the applicant's claim for just satisfaction

anchor.surface_text: 8.  Dismisses the remainder of the applicant's claim for just satisfaction.

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court rejected all other claims for just satisfaction not specifically awarded.
